function.description: Call this IMMEDIATELY BEFORE transferToHuman, every single time. It creates the staff task and gives the person picking up the context they need — without it they answer blind. Summarise in one sentence, and never put medical or health detail in the summary; say "a health matter" instead.
function.name: flagEscalation

reason.description: Why you are handing off. Pick the closest match.

summary.description: One sentence of context for the person picking up, e.g. "Caller wants to dispute a late-cancel fee." NEVER include medical, health, or diagnostic detail — say "a health matter" instead.

urgency.description: Use 'high' only if the caller is upset or the matter is time-critical.
